thread:
laura (support): heads up — CS ticket from acme.ai: widespread 503s and timeouts across eu-west/us-east starting ~09:12 UTC. they reported 'upstream inference error' in traces. escalating.
aj (oncall): :rotating_light: seeing alerts too — 5xx spike, upstream worker container restarts and GPU OOM-ish logs. p95 latency and 5xx rate jumped around 09:12.
vikram (infra): digging into node logs now. I see NVML resets and kernel messages -> possible GPU journal/firmware corruption, followed by process SIGSEGV. snippet below:
```
[09:12:43] infer-runner[pid=4321]: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: device-side assert
[09:12:44] infer-runner[pid=4321]: fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 1, fault addr 0x0
[09:12:45] nvidia-smi: GPU2: Xid 31: Multiple single bit ECC errors -> Reset
```
chris (eng-runtime): any recent hot swaps or quantized model rollouts? SIGSEGV after NVML reset smells like driver/firmware or model/kernel interaction. :eyes: 
laura (support): we rolled quantized v2.1 to a small canary bucket at 09:00 UTC for some customers (including acme.ai). possible correlation.
aj (oncall): immediate mitigations proposed: 1) disable the v2.1 canary and revert to previous variant for affected buckets, 2) route traffic to fallback (cpu/dedicated) model variant, 3) drain nodes reporting Xid errors and avoid scheduling new pods there. applying mitigation 1 and 2 now.
vikram (infra): starting node drain for gpu-rt-22 and isolating NVML errors. kicking off repro job with heavy embed burst (batch_size=64, toolcall enabled) to try to reproduce locally on a dev node. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oom-repro (see steps 3-6).
laura (support): CS note: acme.ai affected ~26m so far, they asked about SLA credits and timeline. I've flagged billing and Customer Success for an update.
chris (eng-runtime): please capture core dumps and `coredumpctl` logs from the impacted containers before nodes are reprovisioned. also capture driver/kernel versions and dmesg. I'll open INC ticket INC-20260318-12 and assign postmortem.
aj (oncall): routing rule applied at 09:18 UTC, temporarily diverting canary traffic and enabling fallback. 5xx rate dropped quickly from ~8% to baseline ~0.6%. monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup: 
sre-bot: Incident update — mitigation applied by aj at 09:18 UTC, metrics show 5xx trending down. next: collect artifacts and schedule retrospective.
laura (support): thanks all — will update customer with mitigation + ETA for postmortem.
chris (eng-runtime): action items: (a) collect core dumps + nvml logs, (b) correlate with canary rollout, (c) reproduce on isolated node, (d) vendor driver/firmware check. will add to INC-20260318-12.
aj (oncall): keeping channel open until all affected nodes drained and metrics stable for 1h. ping me if 503s resurge.
laura (support): leaving a short note in the ticket for billing/sla: impact window 09:12-09:18 UTC (mitigation start), awaiting full postmortem. :memo:
